features: Registration Desk now presents separate Leader Registration and Follower Registration controls on desktop and mobile
Removes role selection from the event-day registration workflow while preserving the shared registration backend
Adds shared StageDisplayService for both real scoring rounds and isolated Scoring Test rounds
Adds secure read-only 9:16 Stage / LED Display links
Stage Display supports individual competitor carousel, autoplay, previous/next controls and an initial grid mode
Stage Display reads competitor photo, name, country, bib and role while keeping photo/country optional display metadata
Test Stage Display is visibly marked TEST MODE and reads isolated test competition entries
Real Stage Display reads real scoring entries; the presentation engine itself is shared between both modes
Generating a Stage Display URL does not alter competitors, scores, results or official points
No scoring calculation or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
